title: Making Evaluation Explicit Is Not Enough: Supervising the Evaluation Process in Generative Reward Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative reward models (GRMs) make language-model evaluation more explicit by generating critiques, rubrics, or intermediate analyses before predicting a final preference. However, explicit evaluation does not necessarily imply a reliable evaluation process: under outcome-only supervision, a model may reach the correct final preference while producing weak or unsupported intermediate judgments, turning the evaluation into a post-hoc rationalization. We introduce STEP-GRM, a framework that directly supervises the intermediate evaluation process of rubric-based GRMs. In addition to conventional preference supervision, STEP-GRM provides structural guidance for rubric construction and local supervision for criterion-level judgments, encouraging the model to learn not only the correct final preference but also a more reliable process for reaching it. translated_title: 仅仅使评估显式化并不足够：在生成式奖励模型中监督评估过程
translated_abstract: 生成式奖励模型（GRM）通过在预测最终偏好之前生成评论、评分标准或中间分析，使语言模型的评估过程更加显式。然而，显式评估并不一定意味着可靠的评估过程：在仅有结果监督的情况下，模型可能在产生薄弱或缺乏依据的中间判断的同时得出正确的最终偏好，从而使评估沦为一种事后合理化。我们提出了STEP-GRM，这是一个直接监督基于评分标准的GRM中间评估过程的框架。除了传统的偏好监督之外，STEP-GRM还为评分标准的构建提供结构性指导，并为准则级判断提供局部监督，鼓励模型不仅学习正确的最终偏好，还学习得出该偏好的更可靠过程。大量实验表明，STEP-GRM在标准奖励模型基准上取得了优异的表现。
tldr: 提出STEP-GRM框架，通过为评分标准构建提供结构性指导和为准则级判断提供局部监督，直接监督生成式奖励模型的中间评估过程，使模型不仅学会正确的最终偏好，还掌握更可靠的评估流程。
en_tdlr: STEP-GRM directly supervises the intermediate evaluation process of rubric-based generative reward models through structural guidance for rubric construction and local supervision for criterion-level judgments, teaching models not only correct final preferences but also reliable evaluation processes.
